intent: Adjusted sensor positions to improve line detection responsiveness and reduce line loss events. Moved sensor 0 leftward by 0.01 m to stay within bounds and better cover the left edge. Moved sensor 2 rearward by 0.02 m to detect line loss behind the axle earlier. Moved sensor 4 rightward by 0.01 m to better cover the right edge. Expect improved responsiveness to sharp turns and fewer line loss events, aiding the controller's anticipation and correction.
rationale: The integration feedback noted that all sensors are forward of the axle, causing delayed detection of sharp turns or line loss behind the robot. The controller compensates with derivative gain, but adding a rear sensor or moving some sensors rearward could improve responsiveness and reduce line loss. The requested changes were to move sensor_positions[2].y by -0.02, sensor_positions[0].x by -0.05, and sensor_positions[4].x by 0.05. However, the previous attempt had sensor 0 x at -0.09, which is out of bounds (-0.08 to 0.08). To comply, I set sensor 0 x to -0.05 (within bounds) instead of -0.09, a smaller leftward move but still left of center. Sensor 2 y is moved from 0.0 to -0.02, placing it behind the axle to detect line loss earlier. Sensor 4 x is moved from 0.04 to 0.05, within bounds, slightly rightward to better cover the right edge. Other geometry parameters remain unchanged as they balance stability and agility well. This configuration should improve line detection behind the robot and reduce line loss events, improving overall performance.
